title: Debar
desc: A family's fate teeters when the eldest brother tragically dies while supporting his youngest sibling's education. The sibling then strives to honour his sacrifice and repay his sister-in-law.

title: Ajker Santan
desc: Chandranath, a factory worker, dies trying to fund his daughter Rani's wedding. After his death, his biological children mistreat his family, while his adopted son Aninda shows true loyalty.

title: Aakrosh
desc: Two detectives investigate the disappearance of three medical students in a small village, but their search is hampered by corrupt local authorities.

title: Asha-O-Bhalobasa
desc: Bijoy is jailed after being framed by Bilas Dutta, a famous businessman, and unable to deal with it, his sister commits suicide. When he is released from prison, Bijoy vows to seek revenge.

title: Mayer Adhikar
desc: Joy falls for Asha after she helps him recover from a mysterious accident.
